map.存 X、贷 (1−X) 时净息为 0: Net Interest Breaks Even at Save X, Borrow (1−X)
map.在存款利率 r_d、贷款利率 r_l 下，使整体净息差为零的存款占比。: The deposit share that makes the overall net interest spread zero, given deposit rate r_d and loan rate r_l.
map.📖 查看「存 X、贷 (1−X) 时净息为 0 使用指南」: View "Net Interest Breaks Even at Save X, Borrow (1−X) User Guide"
map.设存款占比 X，净息=X·r_d−(1−X)·r_l，令其为零得 X=r_l÷(: Let deposit share be X, net interest = X·r_d − (1−X)·r_l; setting it to zero gives X = r_l / (r_d + r_l). To its left saving is better, to its right repaying the loan is better; liquidity, risk and tax are not included.
map.存 2%、贷 5% → 存款占比 71.43% 时净息为 0。: Save 2%, borrow 5% → net interest is zero at a 71.43% deposit share.
map.假设资产=负债规模相等。: Assumes assets equal liabilities in size.
map.手里有笔资金，在「提前还贷省利息」与「存起来赚利息」之间找平衡。: With a sum of money, find the balance between paying off the loan early to save interest and saving it to earn interest.
map.做家庭资产配置时量化负债与储蓄的净利息成本。: Quantify the net interest cost of debt versus savings when allocating household assets.
map.存款利率 2%、贷款利率 4% 的平衡点: Break-even at deposit rate 2%, loan rate 4%
map.设存款占比 X、贷款占比 1−X，净息=X·r_d−(1−X)·r_l。令净息为: Let deposit share X, loan share 1−X, net interest = X·r_d − (1−X)·r_l. Set to zero: X = r_l/(r_d+r_l) = 0.04/0.06 = 66.7%. That is, overall net interest is zero when at least 66.7% goes to loan repayment and 33.3% stays as savings.
map.这个平衡点考虑了风险吗？: Does this break-even point consider risk?
map.没有。模型只比较利率差，未计入流动性需求、提前还款违约金、税负与投资机会。实际决: No. The model only compares the rate spread, ignoring liquidity needs, early-repayment penalties, tax and investment opportunities. In practice keep emergency cash before considering repayment.
map.税率会影响平衡点吗？: Does tax rate affect the break-even point?
map.会。存款利息可能免税或应税，贷款利息部分情形可抵税。用税后口径 r_d(1−t_: Yes. Deposit interest may be tax-exempt or taxable, and loan interest may be partly deductible. Substituting the after-tax rates r_d(1−t_d) and r_l(1−t_l) shifts the break-even point right or left.
